region_scene_page.compact: Disco rose from club cultures where DJs, dancers, producers, and vocalists turned soul and funk materials into continuous dancefloor experiences.
region_scene_page.standard: Disco rose from club cultures where DJs, dancers, producers, and vocalists turned soul and funk materials into continuous dancefloor experiences.
